consoleNav.participantLookup: Look up a participant in Support
consoleNav.privacyNote: Participant lookup requires a support case and an access-log entry. This palette keeps no queries and never searches participant records.
consoleNav.deviceNote: Only on this browser for the current staff member and hub. Nothing is shared or sent by email. Changing identity or hub clears these preferences.
consoleNav.notStored: Preferences could not be saved on this device. Reload to verify your current identity and scope.
consoleNav.shortcutNote: Shortcuts are inactive while typing or composing text, or while another dialog is open. Browser and system combinations stay available.
consoleNav.notificationsNote: Device-only preference for a synthetic preview. This does not configure delivery, email, push or an on-call service.
consoleNav.saveView: Save this view on this device
consoleNav.viewsNote: Only these predefined tabs can be saved. No names, search text, participant fields or private filters are stored.
consoleNav.inboxLede: Review structured requests at this hub. A decision is separate from activation.
consoleNav.empty: No items in this view. Choose another tab or open the owning section.
consoleNav.unavailable: Unavailable: the owning service is not connected. No records or successful actions are simulated here.
consoleNav.synthetic: Synthetic demo. Decisions are simulated only in this browser session; no real approval or activation occurs.
consoleNav.whyMine: Your current role can review this action at this hub.
consoleNav.notActivation: Approval does not activate the action. Activation belongs to the owning form and rechecks authority and the current digest.
consoleNav.unknown: Response unknown. Do not submit again. Check the same attempt; refreshing never resends it.
consoleNav.usersLede: Public participant projections and the correct staff and client destinations. Private servicing always starts with a support case.
consoleNav.publicOnly: Public projection only. No private participant directory, impersonation or participant agent controls.
consoleNav.noHistory: Queries disappear when the palette closes.
consoleNav.reasonRequired: Enter a reason before recording either decision.
consoleNav.syntheticRows: Synthetic example records; no real participants or client accounts.
consoleNav.reasonLegal: Activate the second privacy notice version with its Spanish edition; both have counsel approval.
consoleNav.reasonProvider: Enable the prepared email connection; the synthetic connection test passed.
consoleNav.reasonAutomation: Run the news pipeline without a person starting each step; human decision gates remain.
consoleNav.reasonFee: Consultation commission version 1 for the demo pricing page.
consoleNav.reasonRole: A second compliance officer to review legal approvals while the first is away.
consoleNav.simulatedApproved: Demo: approval simulated in this session. The action is not activated.
consoleNav.simulatedDeclined: Demo: decline simulated in this session. No real decision was recorded.
consoleNav.lostResponseDemo: Synthetic lost-response scenario: the simulated decision is recorded, but its reply is hidden until you check the same attempt.
